aboutSeoDescription: Strideto connects students and early-career talent with jobs, internships, scholarships, and career resources — and gives employers a workspace to publish opportunities and manage supported hiring.
aboutWhatBody: Strideto is a public discovery platform for jobs, scholarships, admissions, internships, programs, and career resources. We organize opportunity and education information so students, graduates, and job seekers can search, compare, and follow links to official sources.
aboutAudienceStudents: Students and graduates exploring education and career paths
aboutAudienceJobSeekers: Job seekers browsing public job and internship listings
aboutAudienceEmployers: Employers who publish or submit vacancies (employer workspace availability varies by launch)
aboutAudienceInstitutions: Schools, colleges, and universities represented in public institution and program listings
aboutAudienceProviders: Education agents and professional service providers with public directory or marketplace listings
aboutPlatformIntro: These sections are available on the public website today:
aboutPlatformJobs: Jobs — government and private listings with application links where available
aboutPlatformScholarships: Scholarships — local and international funding opportunities
aboutPlatformPrograms: Program Explorer — academic programs linked to institutions
aboutPlatformBlog: Blog — articles and guides for students and job seekers
aboutPlatformCareer: Career Guidance — articles on careers, interviews, and preparation
aboutNotClaim1: Strideto is not the employer, scholarship provider, or admissions office unless a listing explicitly states otherwise.
aboutNotClaim2: A listing on Strideto does not mean Strideto verified every detail — always confirm deadlines, eligibility, and requirements on the official source.
aboutNotClaim3: Strideto does not guarantee placement, admission, funding, or hiring outcomes.
aboutNotClaim4: Public pages describe the platform; they are not legal advice or official government communications.
aboutWorkspacesBody: Some organization portals (employer, institution, education provider, business formation) may show as Coming Soon until their workspace is launched. Public discovery pages remain available regardless.
aboutContactBody: Questions, corrections, or partnership inquiries can be sent through our
privacySeoDescription: Strideto privacy policy: how we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacyIntroBody: Strideto (“we”, “our”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and disclose information when you use our platform for jobs, scholarships, admissions, and internships.
privacyCollectBody: We collect information you provide when registering (name, email, password), when you save listings or apply to jobs (resume, application data), and when you subscribe to our newsletter. We also collect usage data such as pages visited and search queries to improve the service.
privacyUseBody: We use your information to operate the platform, personalize recommendations, send you alerts you have opted into, process job applications, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacySecurityBody: We use industry-standard measures to protect your data, including encryption and secure storage. Passwords are hashed; we do not store plain-text passwords.
privacyThirdPartyBody: We use cookies and similar browser storage as described in our Cookie Policy. Essential storage supports authentication and security. Optional first-party analytics runs only after you allow Analytics in Cookie Settings. Advertising partners (such as Google AdSense) are used only when those products are actually configured for a build, and then only after Marketing consent. For Google's ad policies, see
privacyCookieRef: Review or change your choices anytime via Cookie Settings or our
privacyRightsBody: You may access, correct, or delete your account data through your profile settings. You can unsubscribe from emails at any time. For requests or questions, contact us.
termsSeoDescription: Strideto terms of service for using the jobs, scholarships, and admissions platform.
termsAcceptBody: By using Strideto, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform. We may update these terms from time to time; continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.
termsUseBody: Strideto provides a portal for discovering jobs, scholarships, admissions, and internships. You may use the platform for personal, non-commercial use. You must not scrape, copy, or misuse content without permission. You are responsible for the accuracy of information you submit (e.g. applications, resume).
termsAccountBody: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You must notify us of any unauthorized use. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or are used for fraud or abuse.
termsListingsBody: Listings are aggregated from various sources. We strive for accuracy but do not guarantee the completeness or timeliness of every listing. When you apply via external links (e.g. PPSC, university portals), your interaction is with that third party and their terms apply.
termsLiabilityBody: Strideto is provided “as is”. We are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the platform or reliance on listings. You use external apply links and third-party sites at your own risk.
cookiesSeoDescription: How Strideto uses cookies and similar technologies.
cookiesWhatTitle: What Are Cookies and Browser Storage?
cookiesWhatBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by a website. Strideto also uses related browser storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) for preferences, UI state, and—only with your consent—first-party analytics. This policy covers both cookies and meaningful browser storage.
cookiesCategoriesIntro: We only describe technologies that exist in the current Strideto application. We do not use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Hotjar, Clarity, PostHog, or similar third-party analytics/marketing tags unless separately documented here when actually configured.
cookiesNecessaryBody: Required to operate the service. These cannot be turned off from Cookie Settings. Blocking them in your browser may prevent sign-in or secure session refresh.
cookiesNecessaryItemAuth: HttpOnly refresh-session cookies (per account realm: student/user, employer, agent/provider, institution). Production names use the __Secure- prefix; they are Secure, SameSite=Lax, path-scoped to the refresh API, about 7 days lifetime.
cookiesNecessaryItemSecurity: Access tokens stay in memory only (not in cookies or web storage). Bot-protection (Cloudflare Turnstile) may load on auth forms when enabled.
cookiesNecessaryItemSession: Non-token UI caches (account display profile), tab identity guards, workspace realm preference, and short-lived form drafts in sessionStorage.
cookiesNecessaryItemConsent: Your cookie preference record itself (localStorage key strideto-cookie-consent).
cookiesFunctionalBody: Optional interface preferences. You can disable persistence in Cookie Settings; the site still works with session defaults.
cookiesFunctionalItemUi: Other UX preferences such as expanded admin nav groups, career onboarding flags, and portal welcome markers.
cookiesAnalyticsBody: First-party product analytics only. Events are sent to Strideto’s own API to understand page views, searches, and similar usage. This is not Google Analytics or another third-party analytics SDK.
cookiesAnalyticsItemSession: A temporary analytics session id in sessionStorage (er_analytics_session), created only after Analytics consent.
cookiesAnalyticsItemEvents: Event payloads may include page path, referrer, locale, and an opaque session id.
cookiesAnalyticsNoThirdParty: No Google Analytics, GTM, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Segment, PostHog, Hotjar, or Microsoft Clarity scripts are loaded by Strideto for this purpose.
cookiesMarketingBody: When Google AdSense is configured for this site build (VITE_ADSENSE_CLIENT_ID), AdSense may set third-party advertising cookies after you allow Marketing in Cookie Settings. Ads do not load before that consent.
cookiesMarketingAbsentBody: No marketing or advertising tags are active in the current configuration. A Marketing category appears in Cookie Settings only when advertising is configured.
cookiesThirdPartyBody: Some features load third-party scripts when you use them. They are not advertising trackers by default:
cookiesThirdPartyFonts: Google Fonts stylesheets (may involve Google domains when fonts load).
cookiesThirdPartyTurnstile: Cloudflare Turnstile on authentication forms when enabled (security / bot protection).
cookiesThirdPartyStripe: Stripe.js only on payment checkout flows you start (payment processing).
cookiesThirdPartyAds: Google AdSense when advertising is configured and Marketing consent is granted.
cookiesRetentionBody: Auth refresh cookies expire after about 7 days (or when you sign out). Preference and consent records in localStorage remain until you clear them or change Cookie Settings. Analytics session ids last for the browser tab/session. Exact third-party cookie lifetimes (AdSense, fonts, Turnstile, Stripe) are controlled by those providers.
cookiesChoicesBody: Use Cookie Settings to accept all, reject non-essential categories, or set Analytics / Functional / Marketing (when available) individually. You can reopen settings anytime from the footer link
cookiesBrowserControls: You can also block or delete cookies and site data through your browser settings.
cookiesEssentialDisableNote: Disabling strictly necessary cookies or clearing all site data will sign you out and may break secure session refresh until you sign in again.
cookiesUpdatesBody: We may update this Cookie Policy when our storage practices change. Material changes to consent categories may ask you to choose again (consent versioning). For more on personal data, see our
faqSeoDescription: Frequently asked questions about using Strideto for jobs, scholarships, and admissions.
faqIntro: Quick answers to common questions about Strideto and how to make the most of the platform.
faqA1: Yes. Browsing jobs, scholarships, and admissions is free. Creating an account to save listings and apply is also free.
faqQ2: Do I need an account to apply for jobs?
faqA2: For jobs that allow internal application on Strideto, you need an account. For external links (e.g. PPSC, FPSC), you can follow the link without an account.
faqA3: We update listings regularly. Jobs from our automated scrapers run every 6 hours; manually added listings appear as soon as they are published.
faqQ4: How do I get scholarship or job alerts?
faqA4: Subscribe to the email newsletter from the footer when it is available. We do not promise additional messaging channels unless they are shown as active on the site.
faqQ5: Can I submit a job or scholarship opportunity?
faqA5: Yes. Use our Submit Opportunity page to suggest a listing. Our team will review and add it if it meets our guidelines.
faqQ6: How do I report an error or inappropriate content?
faqA6: Use the Report Issue link in the footer or contact us with the listing URL and description. We take reports seriously and will act accordingly.
helpSeoDescription: Get help using Strideto: how to search jobs, save listings, apply, and manage your account.
helpIntro: Find answers and guidance on using Strideto to search for jobs, scholarships, admissions, and internships.
helpGettingStartedBody: You can browse jobs, scholarships, and admissions without an account. Create a free account to save listings, get personalized recommendations, apply to jobs within the portal, and receive alerts.
helpSearchBody: Use the search bar on the homepage or listing pages. Filter by province, city, job type (government/private/internship), deadline, and category to narrow results.
helpApplyBody: Some jobs allow you to apply directly on Strideto (upload resume and submit). Others redirect you to the official website (e.g. PPSC, FPSC). Always check the job detail page for the correct apply link.
helpRolesIntro: Each portal keeps its own guidelines. Those pages require the matching signed-in role. Public Help does not duplicate them.
helpStudentBody: Signed-in Students can open guidance for profile, applications, Vault, and privacy.
helpEmployerBody: Employer help and posting guidelines live in the Employer portal.
helpAgentBody: Agent guidelines cover professional conduct, verification, and marketplace rules.
helpInstitutionBody: Institution guidelines cover programs, intakes, and verification evidence.
helpTopicSafety: Report a problem or contact support
contactSeoDescription: Contact Strideto for support, partnerships, or to submit opportunities.
contactIntro: Use the form below for support, partnerships, or to submit an opportunity. Messages are accepted only when the server confirms them. We do not promise a response time.
contactEmailBody: For general inquiries, report an issue, submit an opportunity, or advertise with us, email the address above with a clear subject line.
contactSocialPrefix: You can also reach us via
contactSuccess: Thank you. Your message was received.
contactError: Could not send your message. Please try again or email us directly.
disclaimerDescription: Strideto disclaimer regarding listing accuracy, third-party links, and liability.
disclaimerIntroBody: Strideto provides aggregated listings for jobs, scholarships, admissions, and internships. Content is for general information only and does not constitute professional, legal, or financial advice.
disclaimerAccuracyBody: We strive to keep listings accurate and up to date but cannot guarantee completeness. Deadlines, eligibility, and requirements may change without notice. Always verify on the official source before applying.
disclaimerThirdPartyBody: Many listings link to external websites (government portals, universities, employers). Strideto is not responsible for content, availability, or policies on third-party sites.
disclaimerLiabilityBody: Use of Strideto is at your own risk. We are not liable for losses arising from reliance on listings, failed applications, or third-party interactions.
refundDescription: Refund policy for paid employer services on Strideto.
refundIntroBody: Student browsing remains free. Institution launch plans are free. Paid employer and professional services are charged by the payment provider when that provider is configured. This page describes refund principles, not a guaranteed commercial outcome.
refundEmployerBody: Successful charges are recorded by the payment provider. A professional dispute, listing removal, or policy issue is not an automatic refund. Refunds are considered under this policy and the provider’s own process when a payment actually completed.
refundStudentBody: Core student features and Institution launch-plan use are free. No refunds apply to free services. We do not state commercial percentages or payout promises here.
refundProcessBody: Use the public Contact form with your payment reference and account email. We do not promise a response timeline. Approved refunds, if any, follow the payment provider and this policy.

careersIntroBody: Strideto helps millions of Pakistani students find opportunities. We are a small, mission-driven team building tools for education and employment access.
careersCultureBody: We value student-first thinking, transparency, remote-friendly collaboration, and impact over hype.
careersOpenBody: We hire periodically for the following areas. Send your CV even if a role is not listed—we keep strong applications on file.
careersApplySuffix: with your CV and a short note on why you want to join Strideto.

submitOpportunityDescription: Submit a job, scholarship, or admission opportunity to Strideto for review.
submitOpportunityIntro: Have a job, scholarship, or admission opportunity that would help Pakistani students? Submit it here and our team will review and consider adding it to Strideto.
submitNeedBody: Please provide: title, organization name, location (if applicable), deadline or last date, official application link, and a short description. Submissions must be genuine and publicly verifiable.
submitHowBody: Send the details to us via our Contact page. Use the subject line "Submit Opportunity" and include all relevant links. We review submissions within a few business days and will add approved listings to the portal.
sitemapTrustDesc: About Strideto, editorial standards, press, and contact.
editorialIntroBody: This page describes how Strideto presents public content: opportunity listings, institution and program information, blog articles, and related resources. It is not a substitute for our Terms of Service or Privacy Policy.
editorialSelectionBody: Public listings and articles are added through editorial curation, organization submissions, imports from official sources where permitted, and approved publishing workflows. Not every opportunity worldwide appears on Strideto; coverage reflects sources and review capacity.
editorialOpportunitiesBody: Jobs, scholarships, admissions, internships, and similar listings are informational summaries. When an official source does not publish a value, Strideto does not invent it. Examples:
editorialOpportunitySalary: Salary or stipend — shown only when provided by the source or submitting organization
editorialOpportunityDeadline: Deadlines — shown when known; users must confirm on the official application page
editorialOpportunityEligibility: Eligibility, degree requirements, and funding amounts — omitted rather than guessed
editorialOpportunityProvider: Provider or employer — attributed to the named organization, not to Strideto unless Strideto is the actual provider
editorialSourcesBody: Where an official website or application URL is available, detail pages may link to it with clear labels such as official source or official application page. Strideto does not expose internal evidence or private provenance fields on public pages.
editorialThirdPartyBody: Employers, institutions, and providers may supply listings or articles that appear on Strideto because they serve users searching for opportunities — not as a separate SEO or link-rental product. Strideto does not operate guest-post or paid-authority pages.
editorialBlogBody: Blog posts show an author name when one is stored. Author schema uses Person only when a real author name exists; otherwise publisher attribution remains Strideto. Articles may include a Sources section when authors add one in the editor — sources are not auto-generated.
editorialAiBody: Internal editorial and admin tools may assist staff with drafting or formatting. Published content is reviewed before publication. Automated text does not replace source verification for deadlines, amounts, or eligibility.
editorialVerifyBody: Always verify critical application information — deadlines, fees, eligibility, and required documents — on the official provider or employer website before applying.
editorialCorrectionsBody: If you find a factual error in a public listing or article, please contact us via
editorialCorrectionsNote: Include the page URL and the correction needed. We do not publish a separate corrections inbox.
